text.Följ alltid skyltningen på plats. Uppgif: Always follow the road signs. The data comes from the Swedish Transport Administration's road database NVDB and may be wrong or out of date. Obstacles higher than 4.5 m are not included. Temporary obstacles (roadworks), local weight limits on individual bridges and spring thaw restrictions are not included either. Dangerous goods data comes from NVDB and does not cover all local regulations or time-based bans. The weight calculation follows the gross weight tables of the Swedish Traffic Ordinance (annexes 1–4) and chapter 4 section 12, but does not take into account special rules for individual vehicles, alternative fuels or exemptions. The driver is always responsible for the vehicle being legal.
text., en liten oberoende studio i Västsverig: , a small independent studio in western Sweden. The app is a support for drivers – it does not replace road signs, local traffic regulations or the driver's own responsibility.
